name: Booking Confirmation
subject: Booking Confirmed – {{trip.name}} | Booking ID: {{booking.reference}}
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

We are excited to confirm your booking for the trip {{trip.name}}. Your Booking Reference is {{booking.reference}}.

Trip Details:
Departure City: {{trip.pickup_city}}
Start Date: {{trip.start_date}}
End Date: {{trip.end_date}}

Best regards,
YouthCamping Team

name: Payment Reminder
subject: Payment Reminder: Upcoming Trip {{trip.name}}
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

This is a friendly reminder regarding your booking for the trip {{trip.name}} (Booking ID: {{booking.reference}}).

Please note that your remaining balance of ₹{{booking.remaining_balance}} is pending. Kindly complete the payment at the earliest.

Best regards,
YouthCamping Team

name: Remaining Balance Reminder
subject: Urgent: Balance Due for Booking {{booking.reference}}
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

This is an urgent reminder that the remaining balance of ₹{{booking.remaining_balance}} is due for your trip {{trip.name}}.

Thank you,
YouthCamping Team

name: Payment Received
subject: Payment Received – Booking {{booking.reference}}
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

We have successfully received your payment of ₹{{booking.paid_amount}} for trip {{trip.name}}.

Remaining Balance: ₹{{booking.remaining_balance}}

Thank you,
YouthCamping Team

name: Train Ticket Details
subject: Your Train Ticket Details – {{trip.name}} | {{booking.reference}}
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

Your train ticket for the trip {{trip.name}} is ready. Please find the details below:

Train Name: {{train.name}} ({{train.number}})
PNR Number: {{train.pnr}}
Coach & Seat: {{train.coach}} / {{train.seat}}
Boarding Station: {{train.boarding_station}} at {{train.departure_time}}

Best regards,
YouthCamping Team

name: Train Ticket Verification Pending
subject: Train Ticket Verification Pending – {{booking.reference}}
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

We have received your request and the train ticket verification for your booking {{booking.reference}} is currently pending review.

Thank you,
YouthCamping Team

name: Train Ticket Approved
subject: Train Ticket Approved – {{booking.reference}}
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

Great news! The train ticket details for your booking {{booking.reference}} have been verified and approved.

Thank you,
YouthCamping Team

name: Trip Departure Reminder
subject: Prepare for Departure: {{trip.name}} is starting soon!
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

Your upcoming trip {{trip.name}} starts on {{trip.start_date}}. Get ready for an amazing adventure!

Pickup Point: {{trip.pickup_city}}

Safe travels,
YouthCamping Team

name: Welcome to Trip WhatsApp Group
subject: Join the WhatsApp Group for {{trip.name}}
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

Welcome to the {{trip.name}} expedition! We have created a WhatsApp group to coordinate details.

Please join using the link provided in your chat or SMS.

Best regards,
YouthCamping Team

name: Inquiry Follow-up
subject: Thinking about {{trip.name}}? Let's connect!
body:
Hi {{recipient.full_name}},

Thank you for expressing interest in {{trip.name}}. Our salesperson {{salesperson.name}} is here to answer any questions you have.

Best regards,
YouthCamping Team

name: Quotation Follow-up
subject: Your Custom Quotation for {{trip.name}}
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

Here is a quick follow-up on the custom quotation prepared for your trip {{trip.name}}.

Please let us know if you need any adjustments.

Thank you,
YouthCamping Team

name: Cancellation / Refund Update
subject: Booking Cancellation Update – {{booking.reference}}
body:
Dear {{recipient.full_name}},

This is to confirm that your booking for the trip {{trip.name}} (Booking ID: {{booking.reference}}) has been cancelled. Any refund processed will be updated shortly.

Thank you,
YouthCamping Team
